info.title: Organization
info.description: Organization: customers, the unit tree (Org > Sector > Department > Section), members, positions, tenant seeds and links. Central or Connector mode.

get.summary: The orgs the caller administers or belongs to (all of them for a platform admin).

post.summary: A new customer with its root unit, the default unit types and positions (platform admins).
A new unit type with the types it may sit under (customer admins).

get.summary: The org's units in tree order.

post.summary: A unit under a parent; a Section needs at least one post category.

delete.summary: Removes a unit with no children, no members and no tenant.

get.summary: The tenant the unit lives in: its own or its nearest ancestor's.

post.summary: Moves the unit and its subtree under another parent.

get.summary: The org's memberships, optionally of one unit and/or one person.
The org's tenant seeds with their status as the hosts report it.

post.summary: A tenant for a unit; its admins become unit admins of it (customer admins).

put.summary: A new version of the seed, which the host reconciles again.

get.summary: The org's org.* events after a cursor, in order (connectors and customer admins).
The org's links between sibling tenants (skeleton: states only).
The seeds of a deployment, as its connector pulls them (service clients).

post.summary: The host's outcome for one version of a seed (service clients).
